label: BANKS DORY
authoring: Written by the rig: DoryIso.byId('dory_iso').walk(), every number its own (mm), stamped with the rig's LF sha256 and fitted to character rig 10.3 (qa.character) by tools/rig-recipes/hull-walk.mjs. Regenerate with node tools/rig-recipes/hull-walk.mjs --write; never edit by hand.
frame: metres; +x starboard, +y bow, +z up; origin amidships, keel bottom, centreline; polygons counter-clockwise seen from above

walk.rule: A step is legal when the target point is inside an area polygon and outside its holes, and |area z - player z| < stepTol. Ramps interpolate z along their axis (x or y) between a0 and a1, and hold z0 / z1 beyond them. cut = the cutaway key while standing there; cutHi / cutLo replace it above / below zMid (stairs and ladders). Polygons are player-centre: already inset by radius, so the reader never insets them again.

areas.note: the bottom boards, stern knee to bow thwart: 3.478 m long and 0.744 m of centre room at its widest. Whole: the three thwarts cross it 0.21 m over the boards and are stepped over (under stepTol), as the owner ruled on 2026-07-22. z is the boards amidships; they rise 0.085 m to the after end and 0.128 m to the forward end with her rocker.

rowing.note: the station the oars are baked to: oarlockPt
the second pair of tholes: a second rower, or the same oars shifted forward to trim her

interact.label: Oars
interact.note: she is steered from the oars, and the oars are worked from the after thwart, facing aft: the tholes are 0.135 m abaft its centre. Taken from the boards forward of it.

cleats.note: the iron ring bolt through the breasthook at the stem head: the painter lives on it
the ring through the port quarter knee: the stern line when she lies alongside

_excluded.reason: the gunwales: a 0.087 m rail cap 0.37 m over the boards and 0.35 m over the water. Stepped over to board, not walked. She has no ladder: a swimmer comes aboard over them (ladderOn).
forward of the walk’s end the bottom draws in under the raked stem: no centre point fits. The painter is worked from the bow thwart.
the after thwart: the rower’s seat (anchors.helm), 0.21 m over the boards. A seat and a step-over, not a standing surface.
the forward thwart: the second rowing station and a passenger’s seat. Sitting waits on sit.
the short bow thwart: a seat for whoever tends the painter. Sitting waits on sit.
the outboard build’s stern bench (state motor), the seated operator’s place (anchors.helmMotor). This walk describes the rowing hull, which is the mesh both dories wear; the bench is not in it.
an open rowed boat: no side deck. The gunwales are stepped over, not walked (gunwales).
the thole pins, a pair a side at each rowing station: they hold the oars, not a mooring line. She lies to her stem ring bolt (bow_1) and her port-quarter ring (stern_port).

fitCheck.note: an open boat: no room faces to check

character.method: every frame of each clip for all thirty builds (evalClip + pinsOf), world opts from the walk; hands vs the wheel rim, the lying body vs the berth outline and deckhead, crowns vs headroom, shoulders (2 x collision radius) vs clear widths

fixtures.what: walk every area (1 of them) at the walker’s radius 0.23 m
fixtures.note: each outline is inset by the walker’s radius, the widest 10.3 build’s collision radius or more: every build’s shoulders fit wherever the walker goes. Headroom is the stand fixtures’; steps are the step fixtures’.

fixtures.what: come aboard from the water (onto gunwales, 0.35 m above the waterline; no ladder)
fixtures.note: no ladder on this hull: a swimmer cannot climb back aboard (see _excluded gunwales)
10.3 has no sit clip: drive is its only seated clip, and its hands hold a wheel
